technology_name: A LARGE-AREA DEPOSITION OF PIEZOELECTRIC LAYERS DIRECTLY ON A DIAMOND SUBSTRATE USING SOL-GEL METHOD
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Depositing high-quality, uniform piezoelectric Lead Zirconate Titanate (PZT) thin films onto synthetic diamond substrates typically results in peeling, high stress fractures, and performance loss.
description: A cost-effective, highly scalable chemical sol-gel processing method that allows the direct, high-adhesion deposition of large-area piezoelectric layers integrated seamlessly onto a structural diamond substrate.
applications: High-frequency SAW filters, micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) resonators, high-power ultrasonic transducers, and extreme-environment aerospace sensors.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
